examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小心端稳，别把热茶洒出来。
examples.trans: Carry it steadily so you do not spill the hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐng dài. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条领带 ('a necktie').

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小晴，今天我的领带怎么样？一滴橙汁都没有！
examples.trans: Qing, how does my tie look today? Not a single drop of orange juice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dān xīn. Common in 别担心 ('don't worry').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bīng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块冰 ('a piece of ice').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 杯子里加了两块冰。
examples.trans: Two ice cubes were added to the glass.

related.gloss: a piece of ice (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì pào shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶气泡水 ('a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 加一片新鲜柠檬在冰气泡水里特别清爽。
examples.trans: A slice of fresh lemon in chilled sparkling water is super refreshing.

related.gloss: a bottle of sparkling water (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cā. Used for wiping tables, drying water, or polishing lanterns.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: léng shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯冷水 ('a glass of cold water').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

related.gloss: a glass of cold water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī péi. Polite phrase when stepping away briefly (失陪一下 'please excuse me a moment').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn gōng shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间办公室 ('an office').

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng lǐ. Used for tidying a room, desk, or luggage.

examples.text: 失陪一下，宋老师，我先回办公室整理一下！
examples.trans: Excuse me a moment, Teacher Song; I shall step back to my office to tidy up!

examples.text: 擦亮铜钥匙、整理领带十五年……三十天就全没了！
examples.trans: Fifteen years of polishing brass keys and straightening ties... gone in thirty days!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo dàn. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘炒蛋 ('a plate of scrambled eggs').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a plate of scrambled eggs (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo chī. Literally 'good to eat'; contrast 好喝 for drinks.

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 小美烤的肉桂卷真好吃！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls Mei bakes are delicious!

meanings.en: for; in place of; on behalf of
meanings.note: Pinyin: tì. Introduces the person you step in to help (替我念 'read it for me').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 放心吧，老陈，我们替你保密！
examples.trans: Rest assured, Chen—we will keep your secret!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuā kua. Reduplicated form of 夸 ('praise warmly').

examples.text: 小晴，炒蛋真好吃，替我夸夸小美！
examples.trans: The scrambled eggs are delicious, Qing. Tell Mei my compliments!

examples.text: 今天早餐做得这么棒，真该好好夸夸你！
examples.trans: Breakfast turned out so well today that you deserve warm praise!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí dìng. Expresses strong certainty or a warm, firm promise (请一定写下来).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn dá. Polite verb for relaying a message.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 等宋老师下楼，我一定把您的话转达给她。
examples.trans: As soon as Teacher Song comes downstairs, I will pass your message on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn yòng. Courteous café and restaurant phrase meaning 'please enjoy at your leisure'.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 您的热红茶和肉桂卷齐了，请慢用。
examples.trans: Here are your hot black tea and cinnamon roll—please enjoy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!
